# TableCell

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the content and styling for one table cell.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BorderedElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new TableCell(options?: TableCellOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Cell text colour.
- [`columnSpan`](#columnspan): Number of columns this cell spans (default: 1)
- [`content`](#content): The content element to display in this cell
- [`isHeader`](#isheader): Whether this cell is a header cell (renders as `/TH` in PDF/UA tagged output instead of `/TD`).
- [`padding`](#padding): Cell padding.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
- [`verticalAlignment`](#verticalalignment): Vertical placement of the content within the row.

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color | undefined
```

Cell text colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `columnSpan`

```typescript
columnSpan: number
```

Number of columns this cell spans (default: 1)

### `content`

```typescript
content: IElement
```

The content element to display in this cell

### `isHeader`

```typescript
isHeader: boolean
```

Whether this cell is a header cell (renders as `/TH` in PDF/UA tagged output instead of `/TD`). Set automatically by `Table.addHeader*` on each cell in a header row, and at render time from the owning row's `isHeader` flag for cells added directly to a row. Can also be set explicitly for individual cells acting as headers (e.g. first-column row labels).

### `padding`

```typescript
padding: Thickness | undefined
```

Cell padding. Undefined falls back to the row, then the table's `cellPadding`.

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

### `verticalAlignment`

```typescript
verticalAlignment: VerticalAlignment
```

Vertical placement of the content within the row.
